verdict.rationale: Amplitude's SDK docs claim a shared identity model across SDKs ('a user instrumented once is understood everywhere'), which implies cross-device identity resolution, but there is no explicit documentation in the pack about merging anonymous pre-signup activity into an identified profile (e.g., identify/merge/alias APIs). missing for 10: explicit docs on anonymous-to-known user merge/alias functionality, cross-device identity resolution specifics, and independent confirmation that merged history works reliably.
